header: Ten years of building the Lodestar archive
subheadline: Northstar Labs began as a two-person reading list in Vienna. Today it runs a peer-reviewed quarterly, a weekly briefing and an archive of 9,800 papers.

items.title: First issue, 180 pages
items.content: Four editors, one printer in Vienna's eleventh district and 96 subscribers who paid for a year before the first page existed.

items.title: The Lisbon studio opens
items.content: Audio production and the Field Notes podcast moved to Lisbon. In the same year, Signal Weekly passed 12,000 subscribers.

items.title: 1,240 papers in one year
items.content: The referee roster reached 210 researchers, and the median first decision fell to 21 days, down from 74 days in 2023.
